hero.title: Site content
hero.subtitle: News and FAQ content
hero.description: Maintain public News and FAQ content shown on Home and their respective pages.

news.title: News
news.subtitle: Create and manage news articles for /news and the Home banner.
news.createHint: Create a new news item. Use Markdown for the body content.

hints.title: Short headline shown on the website. Keep it clear and under ~160 characters.
hints.slug: The URL-friendly name (used in links). Ensure it is unique or leave blank to auto-generate from the title. Example: "visa-updates-2026".
hints.summary: 1–2 sentence preview shown in the news list and banners. Keep it concise.
hints.body: Full article content. You can paste plain text, or use Markdown for headings, lists, links, etc.
hints.publishNow: If enabled, this item becomes visible on the public site immediately. Leave unchecked to save as a draft.
hints.pinned: Pinned items appear first in the list (and can be used for featured placement). Use sparingly.

news.confirmDelete: This will permanently delete this news item. Are you sure you want to continue?

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Create and manage FAQs for /faq and the first three items on Home.
faq.createHint: Create a new FAQ item. Use Markdown for the answer content.
faq.reorderHint: Drag and drop to reorder FAQ items, then save the order.

hints.question: Write the question exactly as clients would ask it. Keep it short and specific.
hints.answer: Write the answer in plain language. You can use Markdown for lists, bold text, and links.
hints.sortOrder: Controls the display order (lower numbers appear first). We recommend gaps like 100, 200, 300 so you can insert later.
hints.published: If enabled, this FAQ is visible on the public site. Turn off to hide it without deleting.

publishRequiresBothLocales.title: Error
publishRequiresBothLocales.body: Publishing requires both locales to be populated

faq.confirmDelete: This will permanently delete this FAQ item. Are you sure you want to continue?
